storyHeading: Go when your calendar says yes
storyParagraphs: Your friends may love the idea of a trip. Getting them to choose dates is a different sport. Solo travel lets you pick the place, the pace, and the breakfast time without waiting for another poll. For a first trip, that freedom feels even better when your hotel, rides, and daily plan have already been discussed with a real travel team.

Comfort Journey has planned holidays from Bhopal since 1992. You can ask for a private cab with a driver, choose a 3-star or 5-star stay, or discuss a palace or villa. If you are travelling abroad, the team can provide visa assistance. During the trip, real people remain reachable on WhatsApp or phone 24/7.

quickAnswer.question: What are the best solo travel packages for first-timers?
quickAnswer.answer: First-time solo travellers often prefer a clear plan, manageable transfers, and time to explore at their own pace. Comfort Journey can customise India trips such as Goa, Rishikesh, Himachal, or Kashmir, plus international options including Bali, Vietnam, and Singapore. You choose the dates and hotel level, then receive an upfront quote and a real WhatsApp contact for trip support.

faqs.q: Is solo travel in India safe for first-timers and solo women?
faqs.a: Safety depends on the destination, timing, local conditions, and choices made during the trip. Comfort Journey can discuss hotel areas, planned transfers, private cabs with drivers, and a pace that suits you. A real team is available on WhatsApp or phone 24/7 during the trip.

faqs.q: Can I customise a solo travel package?
faqs.a: Yes. Every itinerary can be customised around your dates, interests, pace, hotel choice, and transport needs. Tell the team what you want to spend more time doing, and they will share suitable options.

faqs.q: Which destinations suit a first solo trip?
faqs.a: Goa, Rishikesh and Mussoorie, or Shimla and Manali are useful starting points to discuss for an India trip. For international travel, ask about Bali, Vietnam, Singapore, Sri Lanka, or Japan based on your dates, budget, and comfort with travel time.

faqs.q: What does a solo travel package cost?
faqs.a: The price changes with destination, travel dates, hotel category, room occupancy, transport, sightseeing, and visa needs. Share your plan on WhatsApp for an exact quote; Comfort Journey explains the inclusions and price upfront.

faqs.q: Can you plan international solo trips from India?
faqs.a: Yes. You can ask about Bali, Vietnam, Singapore, Sri Lanka, Japan, and other international tours in the catalogue. Comfort Journey can discuss the itinerary, hotel choice, planned transport, and visa assistance, then share an exact quote on WhatsApp.

faqs.q: What support do I get after booking?
faqs.a: You can contact real people for help with your travel plans and practical questions. During your trip, WhatsApp and phone support is available 24/7, and the team can help you understand the arrangements already confirmed.
